title: The Wardens
subtitle: They circle. That is the whole job
description: The guardians have patrolled the parish since the water came in, and
they are very good at it, which is a word that does a lot of work
Two slow fields on one task: the observation asks for a longer look
-- `timer: 40`, two seconds of eye contact nobody should want -- and
`autoSubmitTicks: 60` re-checks it three times a second instead of
twenty, because an expensive check does not need to run every tick.
That is what the field is for.
